nodes.notes: Dialnexa credentials: replace YOUR_DIALNEXA_API_KEY with a real key (Dialnexa dashboard > Settings > API Keys) before enabling this step in production. agent_id = agent_44j7eA1uKPqm2h ("Salon CRM shills", confirmed live via GET /v1/agents). Both metadata.master_leads_id AND notes.master_leads_id are set (Dialnexa's own docs point to `notes` as what gets echoed back in the call.completed webhook payload - metadata is kept too since it's used for {{variable}} injection into the agent's prompt and its own webhook-echo behavior wasn't fully confirmed at build time). The call-fetch workflow (Call sentiment dialnexa / Normalization Engine) reads master_leads_id from notes first, falling back to metadata - keep field names in sync on both sides if either changes. The agent's own call script/prompt (Alka) is configured on Dialnexa's side, not sent from here. Fires without a per-item wait so up to 10 calls in a batch go out back-to-back.
